name: Habit Tracker
description: One line per habit, a fortnight of squares, filled in when you did it. Tap today's check to mark it, or tap back a few days if you forgot; each habit shows its current run and its best, and a gap is visible in a way a checkbox never shows. Collaborators add, mark, rename and remove habits; viewers and anyone the frame is published to see the same grid live. Habits and their marks are the space's habits and habit_marks tables, synced with the space.
